title: Slice the end-to-end tests any way you need
statement: As a developer, I can slice our end-to-end tests by feature, story, persona, kind and more, and run that slice, so I can answer the question in front of me without building a report.
overview: Trevor's direction: there is a suite of QA tools here for slicing this information, and it covers end-to-end tests only. Everything it reads already exists, and this story adds a way to ask.

acceptance_criteria.statement: `query e2e-catalog` filters by feature, story, criterion, persona, kind, code path, and whether a test is stale.
Filters combine, so "negative tests for the checkout feature" is one command.
The QA section offers the same filters and keeps them in its URL.
Any slice can be printed in the formats that run it.
